title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Service Level Schedule: Response and Resolution Targets
content:
ClearPath Managed IT Services guarantees a first-response time for each ticket priority, counted in coverage minutes, and sets resolution targets for P1 and P2 tickets in coverage hours. Resolution targets are targets, not guarantees.

## Response guarantees (coverage minutes)

| Tier | P1 | P2 | P3 | P4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 120 | 240 | 480 | 1920 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 60 | 120 | 480 | 960 |
| ClearPath Standard | 30 | 120 | 240 | 960 |
| ClearPath Professional | 30 | 60 | 240 | 480 |
| ClearPath Premier | 15 | 60 | 120 | 480 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 15 | 30 | 120 | 240 |

## Resolution targets (coverage hours, not guaranteed)

| Tier | P1 | P2 |
|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 8 | 24 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 8 | 16 |
| ClearPath Standard | 6 | 16 |
| ClearPath Professional | 4 | 12 |
| ClearPath Premier | 4 | 8 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 4 | 8 |

## Phone reporting for P1

On every tier a ticket must be reported by phone to be worked and measured as P1.

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

A P2 ticket on ClearPath Professional carries a first-response guarantee of 60 coverage minutes; the same ticket on ClearPath Enterprise carries 30. Because the minutes are coverage minutes, a ticket opened 20 minutes before a Mon-Fri tier's coverage ends on a Friday continues to count its remaining guarantee from the start of coverage on the next coverage day.
